Chemistry 2011-I.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2011-I.question: When items or jewellery made of metals such as copper or nickel are placed in a solution having a salt of gold, a thin film of gold is deposited by
Chemistry 2011-I.explanation: (c)  The process of depositing a thin layer of one metal over the surface of other metal by the process of electrolysis is known as electroplating. Hence,  when items or jewellery made of  metals such as copper or nickel are placed in a solution having a salt of gold, a thin film of gold is deposited by passing an electric current.

Chemistry 2011-I.question: Heavy water implies
options: water which is used in heavy industries such as thermal power plants
water which contains SO4 2- and CI– of calcium and magnesium
Chemistry 2011-I.explanation: (c)  Heavy water or deuterium oxide (D2O) is an oxide of deuterium which is an isotope of hydrogen.

Chemistry 2011-I.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2011-I.question: Which one among the following is a sin smelling agent added to LPG cylinder to help the detection of gas leakage?
Chemistry 2011-I.explanation: (b)  Ethyl mercaptan or thioethanol (C2H5SH) is added during filling of LPG cylinders. It is a strong smelling compound and help in the detection of gas leakage.

Chemistry 2011-I.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2011-I.question: A body is charged negatively. It implies that
options: it has lost some of its protons
it has acquired some electrons from outside
it has lost some of its electrons
Chemistry 2011-I.answer: it has acquired some electrons from outside
Chemistry 2011-I.explanation: (b)  Atoms are neutral. When an atom loses electron, it becomes positively charged and when an atom gains electron, it becomes negatively charged. Hence, a body is charged negatively when it has acquired some electrons from outside.

Chemistry 2011-I.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2011-I.question: Which one among the following metals is used for making boats because it does not corrode by sea water?
Chemistry 2011-I.explanation: (d)  Titanium (Ti) metal is used for making boats because it does not corrode by the sea water.

Chemistry 2011-I.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2011-I.question: Contact lenses are made from
Chemistry 2011-I.explanation: (c)  Contact lenses are made from lucite. It is a polymer of methyl methacrylate. The other names of lucite are plexiglass, acrylite and perspex.

Chemistry 2011-I.question: Water is a good coolant and is used to cool the engines of cars, buses, trucks etc. It is because water has a
Chemistry 2011-I.explanation: (a)  Water has a high specific heat.

Chemistry 2011-I.question: A close bottle containing water at room temperature was taken to the Moon and then the lid is opened. The water will
Chemistry 2011-I.explanation: (a)  The water will freeze because on Moon the temperature is below the freezing point i.e., very low.
